notes: 神→上帝: standard LCC substitution for אלהים (H0430)
UNV {<WH0853>} (אֹתָם 'them') is implicit in UNV but LCC has explicit 它們, so braces dropped and SN attached directly
Second {<WH0853>} (את before המים) kept implicit with braces — LCC has no explicit object marker word for it
滋生→繁殖 and 繁多→增多: semantic equivalents for פְּרוּ and וּרְבוּ respectively
雀鳥→飛鳥: both mean 'birds' (H5775 עוֹף)
Could not verify exact FHL SN tags via API — worked from known Hebrew text and standard FHL conventions; confidence lowered slightly
